title: Subarray With Elements Greater Than Varying Threshold
goal: Find any subarray length k whose every element is greater than threshold divided by k.
strategy: Use each element as a candidate minimum. Monotonic-stack boundaries reveal a span where every value is at least that minimum. The span qualifies exactly when minimum times length exceeds the threshold.
